units.source_text: 此外，在人类看来，河童的生育确实非常奇怪。

en.t: Moreover, from a human point of view, kappa childbirth is indeed extremely strange.

units.source_text: 没过多久，我到巴喀的诊所参观它老婆分娩的过程。

en.t: Before long, I went to Baka's clinic to observe the process of his wife's delivery.

units.source_text: 河童的分娩跟人类差不多，需要医生和产婆的协助。

en.t: Kappa deliveries are much like human ones and require the help of a doctor and a midwife.

units.source_text: 但是，临产时，准父亲会对着准母亲的下身大声喊道：“你想好了要来到这个世界了吗？

en.t: But when the birth is near, the father-to-be shouts loudly toward the lower body of the mother-to-be: Have you made up your mind to come into this world?
Tell me only after you have made up your mind.

units.source_text: 巴喀也一样，跪在地上反复说这样的话。

en.t: Baka did the same, kneeling on the ground and repeating such words over and over.

units.source_text: 接着用桌上的消毒药水漱漱口。

en.t: Then he rinsed his mouth with the disinfectant on the table.

units.source_text: 她妻子肚子里的孩子可能想的比较多，就悄声回答：“我不想生到这个世界。

en.t: The child in his wife's belly, perhaps having thought it over at length, answered in a low voice: I do not want to be born into this world.

units.source_text: 第一，我不想遗传我父亲的精神病。

en.t: First, I do not want to inherit my father's mental illness.

units.source_text: 第二，我认为河童的存在是很罪恶的。”

en.t: Second, I believe the very existence of kappa is a grave sin.
